inputs.description: 17 fixed Boolean-output exemplar shapes over contin (and mixed contin/Boolean) inputs -- bare `and`, bare and negated root predicates, predicates as junctor children, predicates over +/*//sin/constants, mixed inputs, an ignored argument and an ignored greater_than_zero -- plus 3 contin-output shapes with a predicate nested under impulse; each run at perm_ratio -1 and 0 with randGen() reseeded to 1; plus the 140 predicate-bearing combo trees in tools/cpp_probe/mixed_predicate_corpus.txt reduced by logical_reduce at efforts 2 and 3 with empty ignore_ops. No external dataset
